text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("devMinka/rminka", fork = TRUE). Install development dependencies devtools::install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing.
